title: Senior Project Manager Engineering & Implementation (alle genders)
description:
About the role: What's in the Box 
 Are you passionate about turning operational challenges into practical technical solutions? Do you enjoy working across different locations, bringing people together and taking projects from initial concept through to on-site implementation?
 As Senior Project Manager Engineering & Implementation (alle genders), you will play a key role in improving and developing the infrastructure and processes across our European Fulfilment Centre network. Rather than focusing on large-scale factory launches, you will lead targeted engineering and operational improvement projects, translating business needs into practical solutions that make our operations more efficient, scalable and reliable.
 Working closely with local Operations teams, Finance, Procurement, external suppliers and our Automation specialists, you will take ownership of projects from initial assessment and solution design through procurement, coordination and on-site implementation.
 This is an international, hands-on role with a strong operational focus. You will regularly travel to our Fulfilment Centres across Europe, including locations in Germany, the Netherlands and the Nordics, to understand local challenges, coordinate implementation activities and ensure that solutions work in practice.
 What you’ll do: The Recipe 
 Lead engineering and improvement projects: Own targeted projects from initial scoping and requirements gathering through solution development, implementation and handover to local operations.
 Design practical solutions: Develop and evaluate concepts for material flow, warehouse layouts, equipment and operational infrastructure, ensuring solutions meet local business needs.
 Drive procurement and implementation: Coordinate direct and indirect procurement activities, including CAPEX projects, in close collaboration with local Finance teams, Procurement and our Amsterdam-based colleagues.
 Make things happen on-site: Coordinate suppliers, contractors and local stakeholders to manage equipment delivery, installation, commissioning and implementation at our Fulfilment Centres.
 Collaborate across functions: Work closely with Operations, Automation, IT Infrastructure, Tech, FSQA and Health & Safety to ensure smooth project execution.
 Improve existing operations: Identify opportunities to optimize existing processes, equipment and material flows, translating operational challenges into tangible improvements.
 Manage project delivery: Define timelines, milestones and deliverables, manage dependencies and proactively address risks and resource constraints.
 Connect our international network: Build relationships across different Fulfilment Centres, understand local requirements and ensure knowledge sharing and consistency across locations.
 Support operational teams: Provide hands-on support during implementation, troubleshooting and post-launch activities where needed.
 What you’ll bring: The Ingredients 
 Experience in technical project management, engineering, operations, logistics, warehouse design or a comparable field.
 A solid understanding of material flow, operational processes, industrial hardware or warehouse infrastructure.
 Proven ability to independently manage projects, coordinate different stakeholders and drive implementation from concept to completion.
 Experience working with suppliers, contractors or external service providers.
 Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into practical solutions.
 A hands-on, pragmatic mindset and the confidence to take ownership and make things happen in a fast-paced operational environment.
 Willingness to travel internationally for up to 50% of your working time. Regular on-site presence at our European Fulfilment Centres is an essential part of the role.
 What we offer: The Toppings 
 Save on meals with discounts on HelloFresh boxes delivered to your door.
 Prepare for the future with our company pension scheme.
 Receive discounted memberships at Urban Sports Club and John Reed, along with mental health support via Headspace and Spill.
 Benefit from 30 days of paid vacation each year to rest and recharge.
 Travel sustainably and affordably with a monthly Deutschlandticket subsidy.
 Grow your skills through internal trainings, team-specific L&D resources, and a structured onboarding program.
 Work in a modern environment with friendly, supportive co-workers, plus perks like a cafeteria, a Selgros wholesale card, and provided safety equipment.
 Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

title: Staff Product Manager, Money Movement - 100% Remote - EMEA
description:
NOTE: This is a FULLY remote role, but the candidate must be within EMEA to collaborate with their team, peers, and internal customers. You do not have to be in the specific country or city shown in this listing, but please only apply if you are physically based within EMEA. 
 Trusted by 20,000+ property managers worldwide, Hostaway is an industry leading, AI-powered vacation rental management platform designed for professional short-term rental operators. Hostaway brings everything together for greater efficiency and faster growth. 
 Profitable, high-growth, and the first short-term rental PMS unicorn 🦄. Join us at our most exciting stage yet! Learn more about our recent valuation and story here . 
 About the role 
 At Hostaway we are building the financial heart of the platform. Our aim over the coming years is one accounting product that meets the rules of every market our customers work in, and to go further, owning how money moves through our customers' businesses. 
 Few product managers get to build something this important almost from the start, in a profitable unicorn already. It is one of our largest product investments and it will unlock a multi-million revenue stream. You will own it end to end: setting the direction, shaping it from an early stage, and working closely with our C-level executive team. 
 This is careful, detailed work. The rules change from country to country and our customers trust us to get the numbers right. You will find and work with the accounting and legal experts you need, and you will learn the domain in depth, then use that depth to make the big calls on where this business goes next. 
 What you will do 
 Own the product end to end: Set the vision and strategy for a best-in-class financial and accounting product, from first version to a product that works across many markets. 
 Make it complete, compliant and correct: Decide the scope, including the reports that keep customers audit-ready, and deliver it step by step with engineering. 
 Master a complex domain: Learn the accounting rules in each market we serve, starting with trust accounting, until you can make product decisions with confidence. 
 Talk to customers yourself: Turn what you learn from property managers and accountants into clear product requirements, and test ideas with design before engineering builds them. 
 Measure and influence: Set clear success measures, test your bets against data, and work closely with engineering, design, finance and legal. 
 Raise the bar: Set an example of strong product work that other product managers at Hostaway can learn from. 
 8+ years in product management. You have owned a complex product from idea to launch, and taken a product from early stage to maturity over several years. 
 Experience in a regulated field. You have built products where rules differ by country, such as fintech, payments, accounting or payroll. Accounting knowledge is a plus. 
 A product background in a fast-growing company. This is a product role, so compliance or business analyst experience alone is not enough. 
 Proven product discovery skills. You are experienced in Continuous Discovery and Jobs to Be Done, and you can show how you used them to make product decisions. 
 Strong work with designers. You collaborate closely with them, and you can build a prototype yourself when it helps. 
 Rigor and a data-driven approach. You pay close attention to detail, work through complex topics on your own and see questions through to an answer. You define clear measures of success and test your bets against data. 
 What we offer 
 Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive pay based on market rates in the country of the applicant. 
 100% Remote: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere within your country of residence—be it a co-working space, your home office, or even your dining room table. The choice is yours. Just don’t ask to work in our office (we don’t have one). 
 Equity: Every role in our company comes with valuable stock options in a fast-growing and profitable company. This ensures we all share in the company’s success. 
 Values-Driven Leadership: Our Core Values are not just words we’ve written to make us feel good. We leverage them daily when making strategic and tactical decisions. 
 Professional Growth: Our rapid growth offers unparalleled learning and development opportunities, along with a multitude of career advancement opportunities. 
 Annual Paid Leave: The specific amounts vary by country and are aligned with country and/or contract-specific norms. 
 Geographic Specific Benefits: As an international employer, we offer different country-specific benefits such as Health Insurance and Pensions in countries where these perks are customary. The specifics depend on the country of the applicant. 
 Dynamic Team Culture: As a global company with team members in over 40 countries, our diverse and international culture fuels our innovation and creativity, providing a key pillar to our success (and making it a lot of fun to work here). 
 Thank you for your interest. If you apply for this role, you will receive an email from our Talent Acquisition team after your application has been reviewed alongside the qualifications for this role and the qualifications of others who have applied.

 We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

title: Sr. Product Manager, Shopping Experience
description:
About CookUnity :
 Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.
 Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world. 
 If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.
 About CookUnity
 Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.
 Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world. 
 If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.
 The Role 
 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, Shopping Experience to own the consumer-facing surfaces that connect eaters with the meals they'll love.
 This is the most-trafficked real estate in the product. From the moment a subscriber opens the app to the moment they complete their order, every screen they touch — the home screen, search, menu, collections, product detail pages, and cart — falls within this role's remit. You'll own the product vision, roadmap, and execution across all of it.
 You'll work closely with Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Merchandising to make the discovery experience feel effortless, personal, and exciting.
 What You'll Do 
 Own the Discovery Surface End-to-End 
 Set and drive the product vision and roadmap across Home Screen, Search, Menu, Swimlanes, Collections, Product Tile & Detail, Cart & Checkout, and Core UI Components.
 Define a coherent discovery experience across web and mobile that scales with catalog complexity and evolving user needs.
 Manage a large, diverse surface area with competing priorities without losing coherence or momentum.
 Ship High-Impact Consumer Features 
 Partner with Engineering and Design to build, iterate, and launch features that meaningfully improve how eaters find and choose meals.
 Own the product layer of CookUnity's server-driven UI (SDUI) system — thinking critically about how the component architecture enables flexibility for merchandisers while maintaining a great eater experience.
 Drive experimentation across discovery surfaces with rigorous metric frameworks.
 Elevate the UX 
 Partner tightly with Design to create discovery experiences that reduce friction, build confidence, and feel intuitive across every entry point.
 Own the quality and consistency of core UI components (loading states, error screens, coachmarks, modals) as a shared foundation across the product.
 Maintain a high bar for mobile and web parity, while allowing for platform-native patterns where they matter.
 Navigate the Frontend/Intelligence Seam 
 Work as a close counterpart to the Sr. PM, Personalization & AI — jointly owning decisions that live at the intersection of how surfaces are designed and what intelligence powers them.
 Translate what the personalization and AI systems are capable of into frontend experiences that make that intelligence visible and useful to eaters.
 Bring a clear point of view to surface-level decisions even when the upstream inputs are probabilistic, evolving, or contested.
 Drive Measurable Business Impact 
 Improve conversion across browse surfaces (home, search, swimlanes, collections, full menu).
 Reduce checkout abandonment and cart-to-order friction.
 Lift overall funnel CVR and contribution to weekly order frequency and reduction of subscriber churn.
 You Are 
 A senior, frontend-first product thinker with deep instincts for consumer UX and a track record of owning high-traffic discovery or browsing surfaces.
 Comfortable holding a wide, complex surface area — you can zoom out to set coherent strategy across many screens while staying close enough to the details to make good product decisions.
 A strong design partner who can elevate the quality of an experience, not just spec it.
 Technically grounded enough to work fluently with frontend engineers, understand component architecture, and reason about how system-level decisions affect the user experience.
 Genuinely excited by the challenge of making a large, dynamic food catalog feel simple and delightful to browse.
 Collaborative and low-ego at the seam between your work and adjacent PM domains; you know how to maintain shared ownership without losing accountability.
 Rigorous about experimentation and metrics without being paralyzed by them.
 Qualifications 
 8+ years of product management experience, including meaningful ownership of consumer-facing mobile and/or web surfaces at scale.
 Demonstrated experience with discovery, browsing, search, or shopping experiences, ideally in a marketplace or catalog-heavy product.
 Strong UX instincts and a proven track record of close collaboration with design teams.
 Comfortable with frontend product systems (component libraries, server-driven UI, feature flags) and able to partner effectively with frontend engineers.
 Experience running A/B experiments, defining metrics, and making data-informed decisions in ambiguous situations.
 Excellent cross-functional communication; able to influence design, engineering, and business stakeholders across a complex organization.

title: The Flex Algeria: Chief of Staff
description:
Run the founder's office. French salary, Algerian life. 
 Meet the founder: watch this 60-second video 
 About The Flex 
 Our mission: make renting an apartment as easy as buying something on Amazon.
 Renting a place to stay is still slow, stressful and full of surprises. We're fixing that. With The Flex you pick your apartment, book in a few clicks and move in. Everything is handled for you: hotel-level service with the comfort of a real home.
 Started with one apartment in London. Today we run around 1,000 rooms.
 7 cities, 5 countries: London, Paris, Berlin, Lisbon, Algiers, Oran and Constantine.
 First mover in Algeria. We were the first short-term rental company in the country, and we're now the market leader.
 Bootstrapped. No outside funding. On average, revenue grows 30% month on month.
 Powered by AI. Everything runs on Base360.ai , the AI operating system we built in-house. It handles pricing, guest messaging, operations and bookings on autopilot.
 Built for the diaspora. In Algeria, The Flex is becoming the go-to platform for Algerians abroad coming home.
 The role
 You make sure the founder's time goes to what matters most. You run priorities, follow up on every project and keep the team moving. Perform well and you can grow into running The Flex in Algeria.
 What you'll do
 Set weekly priorities with the founder and track them.
 Run team meetings and make sure decisions turn into action.
 Manage finance, reporting and paperwork.
 Prepare key meetings with partners, investors and officials.
 Lead special projects from start to finish.
 What you get
 A French-level salary, paid while you live in Algeria.
 Accommodation provided by The Flex.
 A clear path to lead the country.
 Real responsibility from week one.
 Who you are
 A French-Algerian living in France who wants to build something back home.
 Very organised. Nothing falls through the cracks with you.
 Fluent in English. English is our working language across London, Berlin, Lisbon and beyond.
 Open-minded. You've travelled, studied or worked abroad, or you love working with people from different cultures.
 Fluent in French. Arabic or Darja is a strong plus.
 Comfortable with ambiguity, pressure and speed.
 Some experience in consulting, a startup or operations is a plus, but not required.
 Requirements (non-negotiable)
 Fluent English, spoken and written.
 You hold an Algerian passport.
 You have the right to live and work in Algeria.
 You're ready to be based in Algiers (El Biar).
 Why you should NOT join us
 You want a 9 to 6 job with a clear job description. This isn't one.
 You aren't comfortable working in English every day.
 You need a big team and processes around you. We're lean and mostly remote.
 You care more about a corporate title on LinkedIn than real ownership.
 You aren't ready to live in Algeria full time.
 You expect benefits like health insurance. We don't offer them.
 You get frustrated when plans change every week. They will.
 Who you'll work with
 Raouf Yousfi, founder of The Flex and Base360.ai . He's from Algeria, studied at Imperial College, went through Y Combinator and was on Forbes 30 Under 30. He co-founded Terra API, which raised more than $3M and sells to 400+ companies worldwide.
 How to apply
 Send a short video in English (max 2 min). Tell us:
 Why you want to build in Algeria.
 One thing you made happen on your own.

title: Product Manager (m/w/d) – Praxissoftware im Gesundheitswesen
description:
Rund 7.500 psychotherapeutische Praxen arbeiten täglich mit EPIKUR. Du entscheidest mit, wie sich diese Software weiterentwickelt: in einem Markt, in dem gesetzliche Vorgaben, Zertifizierungen und feste Stichtage die Roadmap genauso prägen wie die Wünsche der Nutzer:innen. Du musst das Gesundheitswesen nicht schon kennen: Wenn du regulierte Software beherrschst, bringen wir dir das Fachwissen bei.
**Daran arbeitest du**
* Du entwickelst die KI-Funktionen in EPIKUR weiter. Sie unterstützen Psychotherapeut:innen schon heute bei Sitzungsprotokollen und Berichten, damit mehr Zeit für Patient:innen bleibt.
* Du gestaltest, wie KI unseren Support für Praxen schneller und einfacher macht.
**Deine Aufgaben**
* Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung von EPIKUR, von der Nutzerforschung über die Roadmap bis zum Release.
* Du übersetzt gesetzliche und technische Vorgaben (z. B. von gematik und KBV) in Anforderungen, die Entwicklung und Praxen verstehen.
* Du sprichst regelmäßig mit Psychotherapeut:innen und triffst Produktentscheidungen auf Basis ihrer Arbeitsrealität.
* Du priorisierst klar und erklärst Entscheidungen gegenüber Entwicklung, UX, Support und Vertrieb.
* Du planst Releases und Rollouts so, dass sie bei Tausenden kleinen Praxen reibungslos ankommen.

title: Founders Associate (m/w/d)
description:
Über uns
Rabot Energy ist ein unabhängiger Anbieter dynamischer Stromtarife für Haushalte und Unternehmen. Mit smarten Einkaufsstrategien und automatischer Steuerung verschieben wir flexiblen Verbrauch in Stunden mit niedrigen Börsenpreisen. So optimieren Haushalte und Unternehmen ihre Stromkosten. Unsere Vision ist es, allen Kund:innen die Möglichkeit zu geben, ihren Stromverbrauch smart zu steuern und von günstigen Börsenstunden zu profitieren.
Warum jetzt?
Der Energiemarkt erlebt den größten Umbruch seit 50 Jahren. Wir verwalten den Strom nicht mehr, wir machen ihn intelligent. RABOT wächst dreistellig. Wir haben das Produkt, wir haben den Market-Fit, jetzt brauchen wir Dich, um den Motor auf Hochtouren zu bringen. Wir suchen keine Verwalter:innen, wir suchen Architekt:innen unseres Wachstums.
Das macht es zu einer kommerziellen Aufgabe: schärfere Positionierung, ein Vertrieb, der skaliert, und die richtigen Entscheidungen auf Basis belastbarer Zahlen. Genau dort setzt diese Rolle an, direkt an der Seite unseres CCO.
Deine Mission
Als Founders Associate to the CCO arbeitest du direkt mit unserem CCO an den kommerziellen Themen, die das Quartal entscheiden. Du übernimmst die Workstreams, die aus der Commercial-Leitung kommen, bereitest die Analysen hinter den Entscheidungen vor und sorgst dafür, dass Dinge tatsächlich fertig werden, eng mit den Teams in Sales, Marketing und Operations.
Commercial ist dein Fokus, nicht deine Grenze. Wie in jedem Startup denkst du das Geschäft als Ganzes und springst ein, wo du gebraucht wirst. Dabei nutzt du AI (zum Beispiel Claude) als festen Teil deiner Arbeit, um schneller und besser informiert zu sein. Es geht nicht um Analyse als Selbstzweck, sondern darum, die Organisation schneller zu machen und das Geschäft von innen zu lernen.
Deine Ergebnisse
Wir denken in Ergebnissen, nicht in Aufgabenlisten. Wenn du erfolgreich bist, sieht das so aus:
 Monat 3 (Ramp-up)
 Du verstehst unser Geschäftsmodell und die Kennzahlen dahinter (Tariflogik, Kanäle, CAC, CLV und Deckungsbeitrag) und weißt, welche Zahl welche Entscheidung treibt.
 Du ziehst dir deine Daten selbst, statt auf Zulieferung zu warten.
 Du hast deinen ersten eigenen Workstream übernommen und ein erstes Ergebnis geliefert, mit dem ein Team weiterarbeitet.
 Du kennst die relevanten Ansprechpersonen in Sales, Marketing und Operations, und sie kennen dich.
 Monat 6 (Performance)
 Du hast mindestens einen Business Case aufgebaut, der zu einer Entscheidung geführt hat, mit belastbaren Annahmen, die du selbst verteidigen kannst.
 Du treibst zwei bis drei Themen parallel und hältst sie sichtbar auf Kurs: Status, Engstellen und nächste Schritte sind jederzeit klar.
 Deine Unterlagen gehen ohne Nachbearbeitung ins C-Level: eine Seite, ein Argument, eine Empfehlung.
 Du wirst als Sparringspartner:in angefragt, nicht nur als Zulieferer:in von Zahlen.
 Monat 12 (Scale)
 Du hast mehrere cross-funktionale kommerzielle Workstreams vorangetrieben, jeweils mit einem Ergebnis, das in den Zahlen sichtbar ist.
 Die Organisation verlässt sich auf etwas, das es vor dir nicht gab: ein Modell, einen Prozess, einen Kanal.
 Der CCO und die Squad Leads fragen nach deiner Einschätzung, bevor entschieden wird, nicht danach.
 Wen wir suchen
 Starker Hintergrund: Masterabschluss und erste Start-up-Erfahrung aus Praktika oder einer ersten Vollzeitrolle.
 Strukturierter Kopf: Du denkst strukturiert, bringst Ordnung ins Chaos und bist sicher im Projektmanagement.
 Analytisch: Du bist sicher mit Zahlen und hinterfragst Annahmen anhand der Daten, nicht des Narrativs. Idealerweise ziehst du dir deine Zahlen selbst (SQL, Metabase oder BigQuery).
 AI-native: Du bist sehr vertraut im Umgang mit AI (zum Beispiel Claude) und nutzt sie als festen Teil deines Arbeitsalltags, um schneller zu werden.
 Kommunikationsstark: Du bringst ein komplexes Thema auf eine Seite oder eine Folie, mit der jemand entscheiden kann.
 Präsenz und Sprache: Du bist vor Ort in Berlin und sprichst fließend Deutsch. Verhandlungssicheres Englisch ist ein Plus.
 Schön zu haben: Python, Consulting- oder Strategy-Erfahrung, Erfahrung im Energiemarkt sowie verhandlungssicheres Englisch.
Was wir Dir bieten
 Ownership: Du übernimmst echte Projekte und Verantwortung ab Tag 1.
 Nähe zur Leadership: Du arbeitest direkt mit dem CCO und dem C-Level zusammen, ein Platz in der ersten Reihe, wie ein Unternehmen dieser Größenordnung gebaut wird.
 Steile Lernkurve: Sales, Marketing, Strategie und Operations in einer Rolle, mit viel Verantwortung und Raum, zu wachsen.
 Kultur: Wir feiern neue Ideen und Ansätze, nehmen Lernen ernst und wissen, dass das Leben manchmal dazwischenkommt, wenn man seine beste Arbeit machen will.

title: Technical Program Manager – Robotics
description:
Why this role matters
 As Technical Program Manager at coera, you'll work directly alongside the CTO, taking ownership of the day-to-day coordination and execution of our engineering programme. You'll ensure technical work progresses, engineering documentation meets our quality standards, and critical decisions and deliverables don't get stuck.
Along the way, you'll build the processes and accountability that allow our engineers to focus on solving complex problems and bring our safety intelligence platform closer to certified, real-world deployment.
You won't be expected to make engineering decisions or replace technical specialists. Your role is to understand the technical work deeply enough to challenge assumptions, spot risks early, and ensure the right people deliver high-quality outcomes on time.
 What You Will Own
 Drive engineering execution: Manage technical workstreams, RACI responsibilities, dependencies, and deadlines, ensuring tasks move forward and blockers are resolved.
 Review technical documentation: Critically assess engineering requirements, specifications, and deliverables, identifying gaps and working with engineers to improve quality.
 Own engineering workflows: Manage requirements, traceability, document reviews, and approvals in reqSuite, ensuring clear records and consistent processes.
 Keep technical teams aligned: Coordinate engineers, safety specialists, and external partners, following up on open issues and escalating critical decisions to the CTO.
 Improve engineering operations: Build and automate efficient processes for technical reviews, approvals, and change control.
 Support certification readiness: Coordinate engineering documentation and evidence for SIL 2 assessments, working closely with the Functional Safety Lead.
 What We Look For
 Must have
 Preferably four years of experience in technical programme management, technical project management, requirements engineering, or a closely related engineering role.
 Strong technical foundation in complex hardware/software systems, with the ability to independently review engineering requirements and specifications, identify inconsistencies, gaps and technical dependencies, and challenge engineering assumptions.
 Experience managing engineering workflows, technical dependencies, documentation, and cross-functional coordination.
 Hands-on experience with requirements management and traceability tools such as reqSuite, Polarion, Jama, or DOORS.
 Experience working on regulated or safety-critical engineering programmes, including requirements traceability, technical documentation, and preparation for external assessments or certification.
 Excellent technical writing, organisational, and communication skills, with the confidence to challenge experienced engineers and drive accountability without formal authority.
 A proactive, detail-oriented approach, with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and maintain high standards in a fast-moving environment.
 Excellent written and spoken English and willingness to work on-site in Berlin.
 Preferable Skills
 Background in robotics, automotive, medical devices, rail, industrial automation, or other complex hardware/software environments.
 Familiarity with functional safety standards such as IEC 61508, ISO 13849, or ISO 26262, ideally in robotics, automotive, or industrial automation.
 Experience improving or automating engineering review, approval, and change-control workflows.
 Experience working in early-stage deep-tech companies or growing engineering teams.
 Bonus
 Experience implementing or configuring reqSuite or similar engineering process management systems.
 Experience coordinating engineering pilots or external manufacturing partners.
 What We Offer
 Join coera at a defining stage, where you'll play a key role in shaping how our engineering team operates, ensuring technical work moves forward with clarity, quality, and accountability.
You'll work directly alongside the CTO, take real ownership of engineering processes, and build the structure that enables our team to focus on innovation and bring safety-critical robotics technology from development through certification to real-world deployment.
 How We Work
 Small, senior, deliberate. We write more than we meet, challenge ideas openly, and focus on building what matters. We value people who take ownership, ask thoughtful questions, and are comfortable navigating ambiguity.
We care about engineering quality, but we're equally committed to pragmatic solutions, clear accountability, and getting things done.
 Process and small print
 Location
 This is a full-time, on-site role based in Berlin. We're a small team building complex, safety-critical technology, and we believe working closely together makes a real difference at this stage. Being in the same room helps us solve problems faster, exchange ideas, and make important technical decisions together.
 Our hiring process
 We aim to keep our process thoughtful, transparent, and focused on getting to know each other. It includes an introductory conversation, a technical interview, a take-home assignment followed by a presentation and discussion, and a final conversation with the founders.
 Visa & relocation
 Not based in Berlin yet? We'd still love to hear from you. For the right candidate, we're open to discussing visa sponsorship and relocation support on an individual basis.
 About Us
 coera is building the universal safety intelligence layer for human-robot coexistence, redefining what safety means in the age of physical AI. Robotics is advancing faster than the safety systems meant to support it. coera closes that gap with multimodal sensing and deterministic guardrails: retrofittable, embeddable, controller-agnostic. Safety is not a checkpoint or a constraint. It is the capability that lets intelligent machines operate freely wherever people do.
